truth: CORE-01, CORE-03 and CORE-04 are closed as construction dependencies. CORE-02 and PLATFORM-00 remain preserved incomplete.

DAW-00A Peer Host Identity is implemented on mergeable draft PR #30, DAW-00B Stable Workspace Identity on mergeable draft PR #31, and DAW-00C Universal FocusContext on mergeable draft PR #32 head a597ff190305a53dcc68f37a44c6f48245483aca. Hosted exact-head execution remains UNOBSERVED where absent.

Global reselection chose DAW-00D because N0TE needs a truthful bounded view of what actually changed in the workspace, including human/external edits, before bidirectional reconciliation or safe host planning can exist.
DAW-00D is the only active increment. Host Shadow is a Technical Twin observation layer, not canonical Song memory, Creative Twin state or action authority.
Host Shadow accepts only verified batches bound to the exact current DAW-00B workspace observation ID and host-runtime fingerprint.
Coverage is explicit FULL or INCREMENTAL. FULL establishes a complete bounded baseline; INCREMENTAL can only modify that same current baseline.
A new workspace observation caused by move, recovery or runtime change makes every prior shadow baseline STALE. Incremental refresh is refused until a fresh FULL baseline is recorded.
A later FULL baseline resets omitted facts rather than carrying old facts forward, preventing partial observation from laundering stale host state into CURRENT.
Actors HUMAN, N0TE and EXTERNAL are provenance labels only and confer no truth ranking.
Bounded shadow object kinds are TRACK, CLIP_REGION, DEVICE_PLUGIN, AUTOMATION, ROUTING, TEMPO, MARKER and TRANSPORT with append-only SET/REMOVE canonical-JSON events.
The Host Shadow semantic harness passed 22/22 adversarial cases before publication. Repository Headquarters regressions are authored; hosted exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
Host Shadow writes only its append-only shadow tables plus canonical Activity chronology; it does not create evidence claims or mutate Song/Creative Twin truth.
No named DAW adapter, process discovery, watcher/poller, feature registry, Song reconciliation policy, DAW mutation, Musical IR, UI or platform packaging is included in DAW-00D.

The Drive selection receipt recurrence was repaired before implementation: DAW-00D title/status had advanced while the body still contained DAW-00A. Receipt bodies must be rewritten atomically when selection changes.
Historical Ableton implementation maturity continues to provide zero scheduling priority.
Direct legacy source/test-text copying remains blocked by LICENSE-GATE-001.
